audit_population: all 600 episode-heldout OOF Actor centers for each of seeds 0,1,2; OOF scores never select thresholds, checkpoints, steps, or seeds

fresh_fd.target: least-squares gradient of log1p(Query J50) using base plus actual clipped displacements

stratification.flat: bottom 25 percent of true fresh-FD gradient norm independently within each pooled seed
stratification.reason: historical stationarity evidence shows direction cosine is ill-conditioned near a true flat optimum

flat_contract.required_behavior: preserve gradient magnitude, allow stay, and do not manufacture a large update
report: actual Query gain after capped unnormalized Critic step
stay curves selected only on inner-selection data in the later OAC runner

routing.critic_only_actor_visited_burnin: allowed if existing global value Pearson and landscape recovery gates pass, even when unweighted near-tie pair-sign fails
routing.actor_updates: allowed only if nonflat fresh-FD gates pass; flat rows do not require direction accuracy and remain protected by magnitude-preserving cap, real Query checkpoint selection, and later stay/guard logic
routing.if_nonflat_gate_fails: start only frozen-Actor actor-visited Critic burn-in, then repeat this audit before the first Actor update
routing.if_nonflat_gate_passes: run the small continuous OAC mechanism pilot with round zero eligible for selection
